id: \bDiamond: My name is Diamond. I have a somewhat natural instinct to judge how a Pokémon feels and am driven by emotion.
en: \bDiamond: My name is Diamond. I have a somewhat natural instinct to judge how a Pokémon feels and am driven by emotion.
it: \bDiamond: Mi chiamo Diamond. Ho un istinto quasi naturale per capire come si sente un Pokémon e mi lascio guidare dalle emozioni.

id: \bBecause of that I've been given the title Empathizer.
en: \bBecause of that I've been given the title Empathizer.
it: \bPer questo mi è stato conferito il titolo di Empatico.

id: \bDiamond: I'm too tired to go again. Maybe after lunch.
en: \bDiamond: I'm too tired to go again. Maybe after lunch.
it: \bDiamond: Sono troppo stanco per un'altra lotta. Magari dopo pranzo.
